summary: OpenSign is a self-hosted e-signature/DocuSign alternative. Parse Server (MongoDB) backend in apps/OpenSignServer with ~70 Parse.Cloud.define RPCs + a few Express custom routes over ~14 MongoDB classes; the front-end is a React app in apps/OpenSign that calls these RPCs. Tools mine contracts_Document/contracts_Template signing flows, contracts_Contactbook, contracts_Users/partners_Tenant multiuser-org model, ContractSignature, defaultdata_Otp, and the admin/self account-deletion cascade.
